name: ECON 3439
title: Urban and Regional Economics
description: (Also offered as URBN 3439.) Economic problems of cities and regions: urban markets for land, labor, and housing; location decisions of businesses and households; metropolitan transportation problems; urban/suburban fiscal relations; urban and regional environmental quality; and the economics of crime.
requirement_description: ECON 2201 or 2211Q. Recommended preparation: ECON 1200 or 1202; MATH 1071Q or 1110Q or 1121Q or 1131Q or 1151Q.
